name: Disulergine
summary: Disulergine is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor which was never marketed. It is known to be a metabolite of mesulergine. The drug was first described in the literature by 1976.

pharmacology.text: Disulergine (INN; developmental code names CH-29717 or CH 29-717) is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor which was never marketed.

uses.text: Disulergine (INN; developmental code names CH-29717 or CH 29-717) is a dopamine agonist of the ergoline family described as a prolactin inhibitor which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dopamine agonists of the ergoline family can cause nausea, dizziness and low blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。麥角靈家族的多巴胺致效劑可能造成噁心、頭暈與低血壓。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。麦角灵家族的多巴胺致效剂可能造成恶心、头晕与低血压。

fact.en: Disulergine is built on the ergoline skeleton, the same four-ring core found in LSD and in the ergot alkaloids made by a fungus that grows on rye.
fact.zh: Disulergine建構在麥角靈骨架上，這種四環核心結構也見於LSD，以及寄生在黑麥上的真菌所產生的麥角生物鹼。
fact.zhHans: Disulergine建构在麦角灵骨架上，这种四环内核结构也见于LSD，以及寄生在黑麦上的真菌所产生的麦角生物碱。
